latest.title: AWS CloudTrail Explained: Tracking API Activity, Auditing Changes and Improving Cloud Security
latest.description:
CloudTrail helps record and investigate activity within an AWS environment by capturing API activity and providing an audit trail of actions performed against AWS resources.
For cloud engineers, CloudTrail is not just a security service. It is also an important operational troubleshooting and governance tool.
